items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: The interviewee (Little Brother Montgomery) does not mention Clarence Jones. The interviewer mentions 'Clarence died' and later 'Louie had offered to go with Clarence Jones', but the interviewee's response focuses on other musicians (Jerome Carlton, Father Hyde) and his own band formation, showing n

ctx.x: Well, Jimmy Hanson, he still was in the crew. He played the blues, and we had Chicago Bill here, he was good, also. Kyle-Kyle Devon, boy, he was living around, and Cripple Clance Lawson.
Yeah, Clarence died, and he was gone.
He was way back, and we had Jerome Carlton around, he was great at the time. Oh, Father Hyde, he had to be great, he was there.
